prompt: According to the pgvector documentation, which statements about HNSW and IVFFlat indexes are true?

options.text: HNSW has a better speed-recall tradeoff than IVFFlat.
HNSW has slower build times and uses more memory than IVFFlat.
An IVFFlat index should be created after the table has some data, because it needs a training step.
IVFFlat builds more slowly and uses more memory than HNSW.
HNSW needs a k-means training step before it can be created.

explanation: pgvector documents HNSW as a multilayer graph with better query performance but slower builds and more memory, and without a training step (it can be created on an empty table). IVFFlat is faster to build and smaller but has a worse speed-recall tradeoff and should be built once there is data.
